## Summary

This is a **Maven** project (Spring PetClinic REST converted to OfficeFloor function injection). The request-handling is orchestrated by per-endpoint YAML pipelines that chain small Java "function" classes. The DTOs (`OwnerDto`, `OwnerFieldsDto`) are **generated at build time** from `openapi.yml`, not hand-written. The failing test `coreFlagsPossibleDuplicate` expects a new **soft-match / `possibleDuplicate` feature that does not yet exist** anywhere in `src/main`.

---

### 8. Build system & test command (answering this first for context)

- Build tool: **Maven**. Build file: `/home/daniel/sandbox/pom.xml` (wrapper `/home/daniel/sandbox/mvnw`).
- Run tests: `./mvnw test` (from `/home/daniel/sandbox`). Run one test: `./mvnw test -Dtest=AcceptanceTest`.
- Important: DTOs are generated by the `openapi-generator-maven-plugin` from `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml` into `target/generated-sources/openapi/src/main/java` (model package `org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto`, model suffix `Dto`). So to add response fields like `possibleDuplicate`, you edit `openapi.yml`'s `Owner` schema, then MapStruct (`OwnerMapper`) maps them. There are no editable `OwnerDto.java` / `OwnerFieldsDto.java` source files.

---

### 1. POST owners YAML pipeline

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml` — full contents:

```yaml
composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

validateRegistrationDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateRegistrationDate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build
build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: validatePostcode
validatePostcode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidatePostcode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold
assignHousehold:
  class: ...owner.AssignHousehold        next: ensureUniqueIdentity
ensureUniqueIdentity:
  class: ...owner.EnsureUniqueIdentity    next: assignCode
assignCode:
  class: ...owner.AssignCustomerCode      next: countNamesakes
countNamesakes:
  class: ...owner.CountNamesakes          next: ensureCityCapacity
ensureCityCapacity:
  class: ...owner.EnsureCityCapacity      next: ensureDailyLimit
ensureDailyLimit:
  class: ...owner.EnsureDailyLimit        next: flagBulkSignup
flagBulkSignup:
  class: ...owner.FlagBulkSignup          next: save
save:
  class: ...owner.SaveOwner               next: audit
audit:
  class: ...owner.AuditOwnerCreated       next: respond
respond:
  class: ...owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
```

(Every step also has `govern: [ transaction ]`. Pipeline order: validateRegistrationDate → build → validatePostcode → assignHousehold → ensureUniqueIdentity → assignCode → countNamesakes → ensureCityCapacity → ensureDailyLimit → flagBulkSignup → save → audit → respond.)

To add soft-duplicate detection you'd insert a new function (e.g. `DetectPossibleDuplicate`) into this chain, most logically **before `save`** (so the flags persist and are read back on GET, matching how `CountNamesakes`/`FlagBulkSignup` work).

---

### 2. Java function classes in the POST pipeline (all under `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/`)

Full contents were read for each. Key points:

- **`ValidateRegistrationDate.java`** — owns the single `@Valid @RequestBody OwnerFieldsDto` binding, rejects future `registrationDate` (throws `FutureRegistrationDateException`), republishes body as `Out<OwnerFieldsDto>`.
- **`BuildOwner.java`** — `service(@Val OwnerFieldsDto request, OwnerMapper, Out<Owner> built, Out<Boolean> sharesHousehold)`. Maps DTO→`Owner`, normalizes address, converts telephone to E.164 (`+61...`), rolls registrationDate to a business day, sets `sharesHousehold`.
- **`ValidatePostcode.java`** — `service(@Val Owner)`. Rejects postcode outside city's region range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); unknown city or null postcode accepted.
- **`AssignHousehold.java`** — `service(@Val Owner, @Val Boolean sharesHousehold, OwnerRepository)`. When `sharesHousehold`, derives `HH-<hex>` id from normalized lastName+address, back-fills existing household members. Uses `ownerRepository.findAll()`.
- **`EnsureUniqueIdentity.java`** — `service(@Val Owner, OwnerRepository) throws DuplicateTelephoneException`. The **only existing hard-duplicate check**: rejects when the full `OwnerIdentity.key(owner)` equals any existing owner's key. Iterates `ownerRepository.findAll()`.
- **`AssignCustomerCode.java`** — sets `customerCode = <REGION>-<HASH8>` (SHA-256 of telephone+lastName).
- **`CountNamesakes.java`** — `service(@Val Owner, OwnerRepository)`. Sets `namesakeCount` = existing owners with same first+last name (case-insensitive) via `findAll()`. **This is the closest structural template for a lastName-based soft match.**
- **`EnsureCityCapacity.java`** — rejects when city already has ≥50 owners (`CityAtCapacityException`).
- **`EnsureDailyLimit.java`** — rejects when ≥100 owners created today (`DailyLimitExceededException`).
- **`FlagBulkSignup.java`** — sets `bulkSignupWarning` = (>80 owners today). **Good template for setting a boolean flag before save.**
- **`SaveOwner.java`** — `ownerRepository.save(owner)`.
- **`AuditOwnerCreated.java`** — logs to `AUDIT` logger after save.
- **`RespondWithOwnerCreated.java`** — `service(@Val Owner, OwnerMapper, ObjectResponse<ResponseEntity<OwnerDto>>)`. Maps to `OwnerDto` and returns 201 Created with `Location: /api/owners/{id}`.

Supporting helpers (same package): `OwnerIdentity.java` (identity key = `telephone|email|householdId`), `OwnerLocality.java`, `AddressNormalizer.java`, `BusinessDay.java` (referenced; not read in full).

Existing duplicate detection is **hard-match only**, funneled through `OwnerIdentity.key()` and surfaced as HTTP 409:

- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/OwnerIdentity.java` — key = `telephone + "|" + email + "|" + householdId`.
- `EnsureUniqueIdentity.java` (in pipeline) — throws `DuplicateTelephoneException` on exact key collision.
- Unused-in-POST-pipeline variants also exist: `EnsureUniqueTelephone.java`, `EnsureUniqueEmail.java`, `EnsureUniqueHousehold.java` (present but NOT referenced by `owners.POST.yml`).
- Escalation exceptions + handlers (`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/escalation/`): `DuplicateTelephoneException(+Handler)`, `DuplicateEmailException(+Handler)`, `DuplicateHouseholdException(+Handler)` — each handler returns `HttpStatus.CONFLICT` (409) with a `ProblemDetail`.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: ".*\\S.*"
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: ".*\\S.*"
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: "The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be valid for the city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode."
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. Optional; when present it derives the read-only ageBand.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even if another owner has the same last name and address.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's assigned customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>'.
              type: string
              example: 'FRA-0001'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the registration date year.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable shared identifier for owners who share a household (same last name and address).
              type: string
              example: 'HH-1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: "The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (email and householdId empty when absent). Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identityKey matches."
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||HH-1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners sharing this owner's first and last name (case-insensitive) when it was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been created today (by registration date) when this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "The owner's membership level from 1 to 3, assigned on creation: start at 1, add 1 when an email is present, add 1 when namesakeCount is 0, capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure)."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The owner's upper-cased initials, e.g. 'G.F.'.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "The owner's region derived from their city (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' for any other city."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: "'EMAIL' when the owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'."
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: "The owner's age band at their registration date, derived from birthDate: 'MINOR' (under 18), 'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65+); absent when birthDate is not supplied."
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of owners matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
